notes: τῇ is unrepresented under rule 54, the possessive adjective ἐμῇ naming the possessor and carrying 'mine own' itself; χειρί then keeps the case preposition 'with' discontinuously (rules 15, 21, 23).
'of me' was folded onto Παύλου as a supplied appositive helper rather than marked 'added', the name being the only token that licenses it (rules 7, 11).
